$comment: ACC v2 — agentd v1.3.1 RESTART_ONLY_PATHS (crates/agentd/src/config/v2/mod.rs). A config diff touching any of these paths cannot hot-reload: agentd reports config.reload.restart_required and applies NOTHING. The operator's diff classifier compiles this list: such diffs ⇒ rolling restart (drain-first); everything else is reloadable at a quiesce boundary (SIGHUP / --watch-config). Live runs finish under pinned definitions either way.
reload_triggers: SIGHUP (--features hot-reload) or --watch-config inotify on each config file's parent dir. The kubelet ConfigMap ..data symlink-swap path is UNVERIFIED upstream (ask U1) — until verified, the operator treats every config change as a rolling restart.
$comment_principals: CORRECTION (2026-08-30, verified in agentd source with the agentd session): a2a.principals is NOT restart-free despite not appearing in RESTART_ONLY_PATHS. Resolver::build resolves every match.bearer_ref ONCE at startup (a2a/principals.rs:365) and reload.rs never rebuilds the resolver — appending a principal AND rotating referenced bearer material both need a restart. agentd docs §11 omitting principals is a doc gap (raised upstream alongside the validate/startup divergence). Operationally unchanged for agentctl: the operator already rolls on every config change (U1). bearer_ref semantics: a secret TEMPLATE ({{secret:ENV}} or {{secret-file:PATH}}); a value WITHOUT '{{' is used VERBATIM as the credential — generators must refuse it. File reads strip exactly one trailing newline. --validate-config does NOT check bearer_ref resolution; startup does (config.invalid, exit 2).
